7th - Gormaanda 8/12/2025 11:27 PM

Individual Immunity Challenge #1: Haggle

For this challenge, all players will have to trade marbles and share information to find the set of marbles that'll give them the most points! Here's how it works:
  • All players begin with 6 colored marbles. They are respectively: Red, Blue, Yellow, Orange, Green, Purple. You also have one wildcard, which can be exchanged for a marble of any color.
  • All players also receive one Rule. Each Rule dictates what a specific marble color's value might be or how a set of marbles would be scored. Here's a rule example: Blue's base value is 4 points, minus 1 point for every Red marble in your Set.
  • During the challenge, players may set up trades with one another. To do so, ping the Hosts in your submissions channel with the player you'd like to trade with, what marbles you are sending them and what marbles you'll be receiving. The other player will then receive your request, and accept or refuse.
  • For a trade to be a valid, each player MUST send at least one marble & both players must have the marbles they are trading for.
  • Additionally, players may destroy two marbles of the same color to forcefully look at another player's Rule, OR one of four Hidden Rules that nobody will receive at the start of the challenge. These Hidden Rules are labelled H1, H2, H3 and H4 & could contain important information towards scoring.
  • By the end of the challenge, you must submit a Set of marbles. These marbles will be used for scoring and any marbles not submitted will not count towards your point total. A Set is at minimum 3 marbles, and at maximum 9 marbles.
  • If two players submit the exact same Set, BOTH WILL AUTOMATICALLY SCORE 0 POINTS.
  • Scoring works in this order: first, the value of all marbles within your Set will be added together, THEN multiplications will be applied onto that total, and finally bonus points will be added on top to form your final score.
  • The player with the Set that scores the most points will win Individual Immunity and be guaranteed a spot in the Final 10.
  • To achieve the highest amount of points possible, feel free to share your Rules with one another - but keep in mind that NONE of the Rules will be revealed at the end of the challenge - meaning you can totally get away with a lie!
